title: Smart Cleaning Business Automation System
short_description: A smart cleaning business system that captures leads, generates quotes, manages bookings, and automates lead notifications
business_problem: Cleaning businesses can lose potential customers because of slow responses, manual lead handling, and unorganized enquiries.
solution: A complete website and automation system that captures customer requirements, generates estimated quotes, qualifies leads, sends Telegram notifications, and manages leads through an admin dashboard.
how_it_works: Customer requests a quote → Lead is captured → Lead is qualified → Business gets notified → Lead is followed up → Booking is managed.
outcome: Faster response, organized leads, less manual work, and better booking management.

title: HouseGlo Wash Website
short_description: Modern website concept for a local pressure washing business.
business_problem: The business needed a more modern website with stronger lead generation and visual trust.
solution: Built a responsive website with clear CTAs, service sections, before/after visuals, and quote-focused contact options.
how_it_works: Visitors explore services, view results, and request a quote or contact the business.
outcome: A professional, conversion-focused website concept designed to improve customer trust and lead generation.

title: Hummingbird Soft Washing
short_description: A modern, high-converting website for a professional soft washing and exterior cleaning business.
business_problem: The business needed a professional online presence to showcase services, build trust, and generate more quote requests.
solution: Built a responsive service website with clear CTAs, service information, reviews, and a quote-focused contact experience.
how_it_works: Visitors explore services, view results and reviews, then contact the business to request a free quote.
outcome: Improved online presentation and created a clear path for potential customers to request services.

title: Custom CRM Dashboard — ClientFlow
short_description: A modern CRM dashboard that helps businesses manage leads, customers, and sales workflows in one place.
business_problem: Small businesses often manage customer information and leads across spreadsheets, messages, and multiple tools, making sales tracking difficult.
solution: Built a centralized CRM system with lead management, customer profiles, status tracking, and a visual sales pipeline.
how_it_works: Users can manage leads, update customer statuses, track sales through a Kanban board, and view customer notes and history from a single dashboard.
outcome: Provides a structured workflow for managing leads and customer interactions more efficiently.

title: AI Telegram Customer Support Agent
short_description: An AI-powered Telegram agent that automatically handles customer queries, captures leads, and routes complex requests to admins.
business_problem: Businesses need to respond to customer messages quickly without manually handling every query.
solution: Built an automated Telegram support workflow using n8n, AI, and OpenRouter.
how_it_works: Telegram messages trigger the workflow. AI analyzes the message, understands user intent, sends a response, captures leads, or routes complex queries to an admin.
outcome: Provides 24/7 automated customer support and reduces manual response time.

title: AI-Powered Email Triage Agent
short_description: An AI-powered workflow that automatically analyzes, classifies, and organizes incoming emails.
business_problem: Manually managing emails is time-consuming and makes it easy to miss important messages.
solution: Built an automated email triage system using n8n, Gmail, and OpenRouter.
how_it_works: New emails trigger the workflow. AI analyzes and classifies each email, then the system automatically labels important messages, archives newsletters, and handles spam.
outcome: Reduces manual inbox management and helps users focus on important emails.

title: Maison Noir Luxury Real Estate 3D Showcase
short_description: A luxury real estate landing page featuring an interactive 3D property showcase, letting users rotate and explore architectural models of high-end villas and penthouses.
business_problem: Luxury real estate listings often rely on static photos, which fail to convey the true scale, design, and premium feel of high-end properties — making it hard for agencies to stand out or fully engage discerning buyers online.
solution: Built a visually rich, single-page website with an interactive 3D model viewer where users can drag to rotate and zoom into featured properties, combined with a premium, minimal design that reflects the brand's luxury positioning.
how_it_works: Users browse featured listings (villas, penthouses, estates) with pricing and specs, then move to a '3D Showcase' section where they select a property to load its 3D architectural model. They can drag to rotate and inspect details, view amenities, and request a tour, plus explore agency info, testimonials, and a contact/schedule-visit form.
outcome: Delivered an immersive, conversion-focused real estate experience that differentiates the brand through interactivity, boosting engagement and giving potential buyers a more realistic sense of each property before scheduling a viewing.
